title: Quietly Quenched Peruvian Duck Picarones
description: A light and citrusy Peruvian dish featuring duck and candy in a keto-friendly picarone form, served in a mason jar. This dessert combines the sweetness of candy with the savory flavor of duck.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, granulated sweetener, and orange zest.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, orange juice, and melted coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a piece of duck breast in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the duck breast to form a picarone and press the edges together to seal.
Place the picarones in a mason jar and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the picarones from the oven and top each one with crushed sugar free candy.
